options.rationale: Terminal sequence ends the system entirely — not a full-moon pause in an ongoing farm.

options.label: C
options.text: It is entirely and permanently terminated — survivors heal and rebuild with reunited cosmic families after the harvest farm ends.
options.rationale: After EBS, invasion theater, dome drop, and EMF, the age of Loosh harvesting is entirely and permanently terminated.

options.label: D
options.text: It restarts stronger under freemason coal monopolies with new 5,000-bed asylums for the 520 million survivors.
options.rationale: Harvest age ends permanently; survivors rebuild with families, not a new asylum farm cycle.

questions.hint: Entirely and permanently terminated — heal and rebuild.
